description: Work with the Scripts panel: list the application and user scripts (optionally with files the panel cannot run, Display Unsupported Files), run a script file (ExtendScript .jsx/.js/.jsxbin or UXP .idjs) with name/value script arguments and an undo mode, reveal a script in Finder or Explorer, or delete a script file listed in the panel (Window > Utilities > Scripts; panel menu Run Script, Reveal in Finder, Delete Script File)

arguments.description: For run: name/value pairs set in app.scriptArgs before the script runs; the values are also passed as the script's arguments, in order

includeUnsupported.description: For list: also list files in the Scripts Panel folders that are not scripts

path.description: For run, reveal and delete: the script file

undoMode.description: For run: how the script's changes are undone (entire_script is a single undo step)

undoName.description: For run: the name of the undo step

name: manage_scripts_panel
title: Manage Scripts Panel
